relations.subject: Johan Frederik "Frits" Staal
relations.evidence: In 1954, Staal earned his undergraduate degree from the University of Amsterdam focused in mathematics, physics, and philosophy.

relations.subject: Johan Frederik "Frits" Staal
relations.evidence: In 1957, he earned his doctorate from the University of Madras focused on Indian philosophy and Sanskrit.

relations.subject: Johan Frederik "Frits" Staal
relations.object: School of Oriental and African Studies, University of London
relations.evidence: he served as a lecturer in Sanskrit at the School of Oriental and African Studies, University of London from 1958 to 1962.

relations.subject: Johan Frederik "Frits" Staal
relations.role: Assistant and Associate Professor of Indian Philosophy
relations.evidence: From 1961 to 1962, he searched as an Assistant and Associate Professor of Indian Philosophy at the University of Pennsylvania.

relations.subject: Johan Frederik "Frits" Staal
relations.role: Professor of General and Comparative Philosophy
relations.evidence: Staal was Professor of General and Comparative Philosophy in Amsterdam from 1962 to 1967.

relations.subject: Johan Frederik "Frits" Staal
relations.role: Professor of Philosophy and South Asian Languages
relations.evidence: In 1968, he became Professor of Philosophy and South Asian Languages at the University of California, Berkeley, and he retired in 1991.
